title: The proposed literal-matchTerms classifier cannot reliably decide whether a semantic category produced a findi
text: The proposed literal-matchTerms classifier cannot reliably decide whether a semantic category produced a finding: the prompt explicitly does not require category vocabulary in titles/bodies, so a valid finding phrased with a synonym will be recorded uncategorized and its category as produced_none. Define a reliable attribution mechanism that preserves the no-review-body-record constraint, and test a category finding that lacks its matchTerms.
